name: HC-SR501 Pyroelectric Infrared (PIR) Motion Sensor Module
core_ic: BISS0001 Micro Power PIR Motion Detector IC
sensor_element: Dual-element pyroelectric infrared sensor with Fresnel lens (120-degree cone)

electrical_specs.trigger_modes: L (single trigger / non-repeatable), H (repeatable trigger - recommended for wildlife corridors)

physical_pins.label: VCC
physical_pins.notes: Must be powered by 5V rail due to input drop on onboard 7133 LDO.

physical_pins.label: OUT
physical_pins.notes: 3.3V logic high pulse upon thermal radiation delta detection. Safe for direct connection to ESP32-S3 GPIO.

controls_and_features.name: Fresnel Lens
controls_and_features.desc: White hemispherical lens with multi-zone facets creating interlaced optical detection zones.

controls_and_features.name: Sensitivity Trimpot
controls_and_features.desc: Adjusts comparator threshold; clockwise increases range up to ~7m.

controls_and_features.name: Time Delay Trimpot
controls_and_features.desc: Adjusts output pulse duration from 0.3s up to 5 minutes.

controls_and_features.name: Trigger Mode Jumper
controls_and_features.desc: Jumper between L (non-repeatable) and H (repeatable). Set to H for continuous wildlife tracking.

role_in_prw_wild.purpose: Detects thermal differential emitted by large warm-blooded mammals in line-of-sight.
role_in_prw_wild.strengths: Ultra-low power standby (50 uA), zero false triggers from inert objects.
role_in_prw_wild.limitations: Cannot penetrate dense foliage, blind beyond 7m, prone to false triggers from direct solar heating or high ambient thermal drift above 37 deg C.
